title: Unbounded rollcall storage enables memory exhaustion
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:114

RollcallResource._rollcalls grows unboundedly with no expiry, limits, or DELETE handler, enabling memory exhaustion DoS.

**Failure scenario:** Attacker sends thousands of POST /rollcall requests with unique IDs. Each creates an entry in _rollcalls dict that persists forever (no cleanup, no expiry, no DELETE method). Server memory exhausted, node becomes unresponsive.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
